name: Ajay
subtitle: 39 · Actor
paragraphs: As an actor, model, and fitness professional myself, my body is my career, and my standards for training are incredibly high. Even with my background, I deeply value Praveen's advanced insights, precision programming, and fitness philosophy. When I needed to get into peak condition for an upcoming movie role, Praveen was the only coach I trusted to take my physique to the next level. His ability to fine-tune elite training protocols is unmatched. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned pro looking for an edge, Praveen delivers world-class results.

name: Anonymous
subtitle: 21 · Student
paragraphs: Walking into the gym for the first time as a morbidly obese, pre-diabetic teenager was the most intimidating experience of my life. I had no idea what I was doing and felt completely out of place. Joining Praveen changed everything.

Over 18 months, Praveen didn't just write personalized training and diet plans for me—he coached me through every single step with incredible patience. I re-learned how to move, lost 30 kg of fat (going from 105 kg to 75 kg), gained serious muscle, and completely reversed my pre-diabetic bloodwork. Today, I don’t just tolerate the gym; I absolutely love it. If you are terrified of taking that first step, Praveen is the exact coach you need.

name: Prithiv
subtitle: 21 · Student
paragraphs: I’ve been working with Praveen for the past five months, with the initial goal of losing weight while gaining muscle, and he has helped me achieve exactly that. He has a strong understanding of fitness and health and has guided me really well throughout my journey.

What I appreciated most was that his approach went beyond just providing guidance in the gym. He created customised plans for my training, diet, and supplements based on my individual goals and needs, rather than following a one size fits all approach.

More than the physical results, I’m especially grateful for the sustainable and consistent approach to fitness that I’ve developed through working with Praveen. That has been the biggest achievement for me and something I feel I can maintain long term.

Praveen has always been professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to helping me improve. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for personalised and reliable guidance on their fitness journey.

name: Diya
subtitle: 27 · Marketing professional
paragraphs: When I first started working with Praveen, I had been struggling with PCOS, insulin resistance, and excess body fat. I had already been working with my gynecologist, but I was still finding it difficult to make meaningful progress with my fitness, and I was feeling tired all the time.

Working with Praveen was a gradual process rather than a quick transformation. He made me understand the importance of building muscle rather than just chasing a lower number on the scale. Over the course of a couple of years, we built a consistent approach to strength training, nutrition, and lifestyle habits that I could actually maintain.

As I became stronger and more consistent, I gradually lost body fat and gained muscle, and my overall fitness and confidence improved significantly. Over time, I also saw improvements in my bloodwork and a reduction in some of the symptoms I had been experiencing.

What stood out most to me was his empathetic approach. I felt I could tell him anything. Even if I overate or missed a workout, he was always patient and understanding. He never made me feel guilty or treated progress as something that had to happen overnight. He adjusted my training and approach as I progressed, explained the reasoning behind what we were doing, and helped me develop habits that I could sustain long term.
Working with Praveen, I have learned to love my body and care for it. I'm very grateful for the guidance and support he provided throughout my journey.

name: Aman Duggal
subtitle: Founder & Director · Champions College of Sports Science
paragraphs: Having mentored Praveen during my intensive fitness program, I can confidently say he possesses a strong foundation in exercise science and a genuine dedication to client success. He consistently demonstrated a sharp understanding of training principles and, more importantly, the ability to apply them effectively in practice. Praveen stands out as a highly capable, knowledgeable professional who brings immense value to the fitness industry.

name: Saravanan
subtitle: ACE Certified Personal Trainer
paragraphs: I have known Praveen for 8 years. I have seen him train multiple clients with different needs, and from day one, he has had the same energy level and involvement towards his job.
He is highly knowledgeable, punctual, and accountable in every aspect. I have never seen him overtrain a client; he exactly identifies and examines the client's condition and trains them accordingly.

name: SH
subtitle: 26 · Engineer
paragraphs: Praveen and I have been training together for almost 4 years, and what really sets him apart is the way he approaches training. It’s never just about memorizing exercises or checking if your form is right …. he always brings a science-backed approach to everything he does.

He understands that everyone has different goals and knows exactly what kind of training would work best, whether it’s strength training, isometrics, muscle building, or something more specific to your needs.

Over the years, I’ve always trusted his knowledge and advice. He has helped me work around many injuries and regain confidence in my own body. Beyond that, he’s been a wonderful support and a great gym buddy. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for someone who genuinely understands the science behind training.

name: Vinoth
subtitle: 46 · Former State-level Boxer · PhD Candidate / Researcher
paragraphs: Training with you has been both inspiring and genuinely enjoyable. What sets you apart is your unique, thoughtful approach to strength training—you don’t just focus on lifting more, but on understanding movement, biomechanics, and the quality of every rep.

Working alongside you helped me develop a much better understanding of proper technique, body mechanics, and how to train intelligently for sustainable strength gains. Your approach made me more aware of how I move and gave me greater confidence in my training.

Beyond the knowledge and results, I truly valued the energy, encouragement, and camaraderie you brought to every workout. You’ve been more than just a great gym mate—you’ve been a source of inspiration and someone who has genuinely influenced the way I train.
I’m grateful for everything I’ve learned from you and for the progress we achieved together. If anyone wants to achieve a realistic fitness goal, I truly recommend him.

name: Syed
subtitle: 65 · Lawyer
paragraphs: When I first started training with Praveen, I was going through a difficult period in my life. At 65, I was recovering from locally advanced prostate cancer and dealing with the muscle loss and weakness caused by androgen deprivation therapy. I also have severe osteoporosis, sciatica, thalassemia minor, and some balance problems, including a chronic foot drop.
I was understandably nervous about exercising. I needed someone who would understand my context and help me regain my strength without putting me at unnecessary risk.

I've been training with Praveen for the past six months, and the difference has been remarkable. He has been incredibly patient and thoughtful in the way he approaches my training. We mostly use machines and carefully selected exercises, and he is always mindful of my balance, my back, and how I'm feeling on any given day. He also makes sure I get enough rest and never pushes me beyond what I can comfortably manage.
I'm now noticeably stronger, my walking and balance have improved, and I can even manage 30 minutes on the elliptical! That's something I wouldn't have imagined doing six months ago.
But what I'm most grateful for is how much better I feel in everyday life. I have more confidence in my body, I'm more independent, and my overall mood has improved tremendously.

Praveen genuinely cares about the people he trains. He listens, explains things clearly, and always makes me feel comfortable and supported. I would happily recommend him, especially to older people or anyone dealing with health challenges who might feel intimidated about getting started.
